pullRequest.title: Waiting list once a walk is full
pullRequest.body:
Walks have been going out overbooked. The council's street-performance licence allows 20 people on a walk (the guide doesn't count), so the guide sheet now confirms bookings up to that and puts the rest on a waiting list the guide can ring if anyone doesn't turn up.

First come, first served, in the order bookings were taken, and a party is never split. Once a party doesn't fit, it and every booking after it go on the waiting list, so nobody jumps the queue, even a smaller party that would fit.

The limit is the licence's: Bethan agrees any change with the council's licensing team first.
pullRequest.author: ffion

comments.author: tomos
comments.body: Could the heading say how many places are left, like `3 places left`, or `full` when there are none? Then I know at a glance whether to ring round.
